sessions.title: Fix flaky reconnect in the event stream

turns.text: The event stream sometimes stops after the laptop sleeps, and only a reload brings it back.

The retry timer is cleared on `visibilitychange` and never armed again, so a socket that dies during sleep stays dead.

I moved the timer into the connection state and added a jittered backoff:

```ts
const delay = Math.min(30_000, 500 * 2 ** attempt) * (0.5 + Math.random() / 2)
retry = setTimeout(connect, delay)
```

The stream now comes back within a few seconds of waking.
After I rename a session, the sidebar keeps the old title until I restart. Why?

The sidebar store copies each session's title when the list loads and never listens for `session.renamed`.

I added the handler and a test:

```ts
events.on("session.renamed", ({ sessionID, title }) => {
  store.update(sessionID, (s) => ({ ...s, title }))
})
```

Renames now show up in the sidebar within a frame.

The plan is in [docs/proposal.md](docs/proposal.md), and why the store owns the title is in [docs/first-principles.md](docs/first-principles.md).

+  const events = createEvents()
+  const store = createSidebarStore(events)
+  events.emit("sessions.loaded", [{ id: "a", title: "Old" }])
+  events.emit("session.renamed", { sessionID: "a", title: "New" })
+  expect(store.get("a").title).toBe("New")
+})

turns.text: Add arrow keys and Enter to the command bar.
Up and Down now move through the results, Enter runs the highlighted one, and Escape closes the bar. The highlight wraps at both ends.

sessions.title: Explain the tile cache eviction policy

turns.text: How does the tile cache decide what to evict?

It is an LRU with two rules on top:

- Tiles on screen are pinned and never evicted.
- Lower zoom levels count double, because they are the fallback while panning.

Eviction runs when the cache passes 80% of its budget, and stops at 60%.

sessions.title: Fix footnote numbering in exported PDFs

turns.text: Footnotes restart at 1 on every page of the PDF.
The counter lived on the page object. It now lives on the document, so numbering runs through the whole export.

files.diff:
@@ -30,4 +30,4 @@ def number(note, page):
-    page.notes += 1
-    note.number = page.notes
+    page.document.notes += 1
+    note.number = page.document.notes

sessions.title: Retry uploads after a dropped connection

turns.text: Uploads fail for good when the connection drops. Can they resume?
Each chunk is now retried up to five times, and a resumed upload asks the server for its offset first, so nothing is sent twice.

sessions.title: Profile scroll jank in long transcripts

turns.text: Scrolling stutters once a transcript passes a few hundred messages.
Every row measures itself on scroll, which forces a layout per row. Caching heights by message id takes a long scroll from 31 ms a frame to about 6 ms.

docs.docs/proposal.md:
# Keep the sidebar in step

A rename reaches the server and the open session, but the sidebar keeps the title it copied when the list loaded.

## Plan

1. Listen for `session.renamed` in the sidebar store.
2. Update that one session in place.
3. Cover it with a test that renames and reads the store.

No other view changes: they all read the store.
docs.docs/first-principles.md:
# Who owns a title

A title has one owner: the store. Views read it and keep no copy, so a change has one place to land.

When a view needs a title sooner than the store has it, the answer is a faster store, not a second copy.
